{{Current events|year=2021|month=12|day=27|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Late December 2021 Bahia floods]]
**[[Flood]]ing in the [[Bahia]] [[states of Brazil|state]] of [[Northeast Region, Brazil|Northeast]] [[Brazil]] kills 18 people. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/dams-burst-northeastern-brazil-region-hit-floods-rcna10031 (NBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kerala]]
*****The Indian state of [[Kerala]] imposes a nighttime curfew from December 30 to January 2 in order to reduce the spread of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant|Omicron]] variant. [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/coronavirus/covid-19-kerala-to-impose-night-curfew-as-omicron-cases-spike (''Khaleej Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel]]
****The [[Sheba Medical Center]] near [[Tel Aviv]], [[Israel]], begins the world's first clinical trial of fourth doses of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]], involving 150 medical personnel, in order to determine if a fourth dose can provide extra immunity against [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.voanews.com/amp/israel-begins-clinical-trial-of-fourth-covid-19-vaccine-shot-/6371244.html (Voice of America)]
****The [[Ministry of Health (Israel)|health ministry]] reduces the interval between the second dose and booster dose of the COVID-19 vaccine to three months, citing concerns about the spread of the Omicron variant. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-to-offer-covid-boosters-3-months-after-second-vaccine-dose/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]], [[COVID-19 drug development]]
****[[South Korea]] authorizes the emergency use of the anti-viral oral drug [[Paxlovid]] manufactured by [[Pfizer]] for high-risk patients over the age of 12 years, becoming the first drug to be approved for use in the country. [https://m-en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20211227004551320?section=news (Yonhap News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]]
****The Ministry of Health and Prevention approves the emergency use of [[Sinopharm (company)|Sinopharm]]'s new recombinant protein vaccine. [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/article/uae-approves-sinopharms-new-covid-19-vaccine (''Khaleej Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland]]
****[[COVID-19 drug development]]
*****[[Swissmedic]] approves the use of the [[monoclonal antibody]] cocktail [[Ronapreve]] developed by [[Roche]] and [[Regeneron]] to treat severe COVID-19 patients. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/swiss-regulator-approves-roche-regeneron-covid-19-drug/47220324 (Swissinfo)]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Switzerland]]
*****Swissmedic approves the use of the [[Janssen COVID-19 vaccine]] as a booster dose for people over the age of 18 years, which can be administered two months after the first dose, or six months after a person receives mixed vaccinations with mRNA-based vaccines. [https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/swissmedic-approves-jj-covid-19-vaccine-booster-2021-12-27/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France|French]] [[Prime Minister of France|prime minister]] [[Jean Castex]] announces that, for the next three weeks, all public gatherings will be limited to 2,000 people indoors and 5,000 people outdoors. Work from home will be mandated where possible, and [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|outdoor mask wearing]] will be mandatory in city centres. The interval between the second dose and the booster dose of the COVID-19 vaccine will also be reduced to three months in response to the rapid spread of the Omicron variant. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/dec/27/france-cuts-third-booster-jab-delay-to-three-months-amid-omicron-spread (''The Guardian'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****The [[Greece|Greek]] [[Government of Greece|government]] announces new restrictions that will be in effect from January 3 until at least January 16, which include mandatory high-protection or double [[Cloth face mask|mask]] wearing in [[supermarket]]s and on [[public transport]], closure of entertainment and hospitality venues at midnight, reinstating [[work from home]] policies for up to 50% of employees, and reducing the capacity of sports stadiums to 10%. This comes after the country reported a record 9,284 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1174540/gov-t-announces-new-covid-restrictions-for-jan-3-16/ (''Kathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iceland]]
****[[Iceland]] reports a record 672 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.livemint.com/news/world/denmark-iceland-report-record-covid-cases-as-omicron-surges-11640623154048.html (''Mint'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales]]
****[[New South Wales]] reports [[Australia]]'s first confirmed death from the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in a fully vaccinated man in his 80s who had experienced breakthrough infections and also had underlying health conditions. [https://thehill.com/blogs/blog-briefing-room/news/587348-australias-new-south-wales-records-first-omicron-death (''The Hill'')]
****[[Sydney]]'s [[St. Vincent's Hospital, Sydney|St. Vincent's Hospital]] incorrectly issues premature negative COVID-19 test results to 1,395 people who had actually tested positive in the past 48 hours. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-12-27/sydpath-sends-another-995-wrong-covid-19-test-results/100726028, (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Australia]]
****[[South Australia]] reports a record 842 new cases in the past 24 hours. The state also reports their first death from COVID-19 since April 2020 in a 92-year-old woman. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-12-27/sa-records-842-new-covid-cases-as-death-investigated/100726626 (ABC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
***[[Canada]] surpasses two million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/coronavirus/canada-surpasses-2-million-covid-19-cases-since-start-of-pandemic-1.5720515 (CTV News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Paraguay]]
***[[Paraguay]] reports its first cases of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in three people who travelled outside the country earlier this month. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/paraguay-confirms-first-cases-omicron-variant-coronavirus-2021-12-27/ (Reuters)]
*[[2020–2021 H5N8 outbreak]]
**A [[bird flu]] outbreak in [[northern Israel]] kills at least 5,200 migratory [[Crane (bird)|cranes]] and forces farmers to slaughter hundreds of thousands of [[chicken]]s in what authorities say is the deadliest [[Wildlife of Israel|wildlife]] disaster in the nation's history. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/thousands-of-cranes-killed-by-bird-flu-in-northern-israel/2021/12/27/bc9b69b4-6748-11ec-9390-eae241f4c8b1_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
